tool_input.description: 确认公司服务默认数据源
tool_input.command:
$login = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://192.168.1.12:8848/nacos/v1/auth/login' -Method Post -ContentType 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' -Body 'username=nacos&password={{ov_privacy:default:viking://~/privacy/credential/nacos-taicang-dev#/values/password}}' -SkipHttpErrorCheck -TimeoutSec 15
$token = [string](($login.Content | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop).accessToken)
$uri = 'http://192.168.1.12:8848/nacos/v1/cs/configs?dataId=zhishu-company-dev.yml&group=DEFAULT_GROUP&tenant=zscloud&accessToken=' + [uri]::EscapeDataString($token)
$text = [string](Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $uri -Method Get -SkipHttpErrorCheck -TimeoutSec 15).Content
$primary = [regex]::Match($text, '(?im)^\s*primary\s*:\s*([^\s#]+)')
if ($primary.Success) { 'DATASOURCE_PRIMARY=' + $primary.Groups[1].Value } else { 'DATASOURCE_PRIMARY=framework-default-master' }
$labels = [regex]::Matches($text, '(?m)^\s{8}([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*)\s*:') | ForEach-Object { $_.Groups[1].Value }
'DATASOURCE_LABELS=' + (($labels | Where-Object { $_ -in 'master','slavetwo' }) -join ',')
